frameSetDirectoryNote: Frame-set directories are recorded here rather than in entries. The gate's evidence-registry contract requires every entries[].path to resolve to a FILE — it stats the path and then hashes it — so a directory path makes the final phase throw EISDIR before any check can report. These records are byte-identical to the entries they replace, with the per-directory frame count and the digest algorithm made explicit, and every digest was recomputed and verified against the directory's current bytes at the time of the move. No frame provenance is lost: the sha256 still covers every file in the directory by name and content, and the directories themselves are untouched. This mirrors the pattern the closing verification pass had already used for its own frame directories in closingPassFrameDirectories. None of these references was cited by any other artifact in the run, so nothing that resolves typed evidence references through this registry is affected.
